tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind every card. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, the header, form fields, the Help box and the table card. Text on it is `ink`; links and accent text are `green`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All body text, headings, outlines of secondary buttons, the table header rule, and the dark summary card (text on that card is `card`). Reads on `ground` and `card`.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Main accent: step number circles, the Apply and Discover buttons (text on them is `card`), links, the left rule of the Help box, the second group in a comparison. Reads on `card` and `ground`.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Bar fills for the first group in a comparison. Use for shapes only, never for text: it is too light on white. Use `orange-text` for orange text.

tokens.name: orange-text
tokens.usage: Big orange figures such as the 23% in a stat card, on `card`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Thin dividers: header underline and table row lines. Decorative only.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: 2px border of dropdowns and the search box, on `card`.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Empty part of a bar behind its orange or green fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 3px outline on any control reached with the Tab key. Kept as designed, but it is only about 1.8 to 1 against `ground`, below the 3 to 1 guidance for focus rings. If your tutor or a checker flags it, switch the outline to `ink`.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The one h1 on each page.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: One sentence under the page title saying what the page is for.
styles.sample: Filter the data to see who delays care because of cost.

styles.name: section-heading
styles.usage: h2 for each block, such as Filter or Your results.

styles.name: nav-link
styles.usage: Home, Explore and About in the header.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text, dropdown text and table text on small screens. Never go smaller than `note`.
styles.sample: Showing results for: Specialist, ages 65 to 74

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Label above every dropdown, always visible.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: Smallest text: the left-out note and the source line.
styles.sample: People who did not need the service, or did not answer, are left out.

styles.name: table-text
styles.usage: Text inside the results table and the step tiles on 1B.

styles.name: step-title
styles.usage: Question beside a step number, and the title of a tile or persona card.
styles.sample: Who do you want to look at?

styles.name: stat-sentence
styles.usage: The plain-English result sentence on the dark summary card.

styles.name: stat-figure
styles.usage: The one big percentage on a stat card.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its field, and between a page title and its lead.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between the search box and its button, and between lines inside a card.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between fields in a row and between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Gap between a step number and its fields, between cards in a row, and between blocks inside a form.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Padding inside cards and the side gutter of the page.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Gap between the main blocks of a page and padding of the dark summary card.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Space above the page content under the header.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Widest the content column and the header may be.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Height of dropdowns, the search box, the Search button and the step number circle.

tokens.name: control-h-lg
tokens.usage: Height of large buttons: Apply, Discover and Reset.

tokens.name: radius-select
tokens.usage: Dropdowns.

tokens.name: radius-photo
tokens.usage: Persona photos.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: Bars: half of their 24px height.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and the Help box.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Half of a 56px control: search box and Search button. Nav links use it too. The step number circle is the same shape, written as 50% in CSS.

tokens.name: radius-pill-lg
tokens.usage: Half of a 64px button: Apply, Discover and Reset.
